{{Top|leg}}
'''Stellaphones''' were communication devices. The [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency recommended the use of stellaphones on the [[Tomorrowland Starport]] to make calls to [[Earth/Legends|Earth]], instead of using [[Star*Link]].
